Name: WSilenceW's Harry Potter Gryffindor Collection(PIF)(FF)(AT)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
1.1.0版本更新：增加几样圣诞家具
Version 1.1.0 Update: Added several Christmas furniture items

=======================================================


Mod内容：

PIF房间：
增加一个格兰芬多公共休息室风格的房间地图，需要PIF前置mod（Personal Rooms），通过装饰门进入；房间地板可以更换，能够放置床；

FF家具：增加一些格兰芬多风格的家具，需要FF3.0前置mod（FurnitureFramework3.0）。
1、格兰芬多家具目录：在罗宾的商店购买，或者从游戏内原有的“家具目录”获取；
2、格兰芬多学院地毯：长方形地毯；
3、飞天汽车与守护神咒窗景：随日夜变化；
4、云海与猫头鹰窗景：随日夜变化；
5、楼梯间小窗：随日夜变化；
6、格兰芬多之剑：墙饰，带灯光；
7、熄灯器：动态装饰，可以放在桌面上，带灯光；
8、红焰火焰杯：右键开关火光；
9、火弩箭座椅：右侧有两个座位，右键坐上座椅;
10、圣诞动态雪景窗景：动态装饰，带灯光；
11、雪人灯架：动态装饰，带灯光。

AT家具：增加一些格兰芬多风格的家具，需要AT前置mod（Alternative Textures），具体家具内容参考详情图。


FF家具和AT家具并非相同家具的不同版本，而是共同组成完整的一套家具，所以两个家具前置mod都需要下载哦~

Mod Content:

PIF Room:
Adds a Gryffindor Common Room-style map.Requires the PIF (Personal Rooms) mod as a prerequisite.Accessed via a decorative door.The room's flooring can be changed, and a bed can be placed inside.

FF Furniture:
Adds a selection of Gryffindor-themed furniture.Requires the FF 3.0 (Furniture Framework 3.0) mod as a prerequisite.
  1. Gryffindor Furniture Catalog: Purchase from Robin's shop or obtain from the vanilla Furniture Catalog.
  2. Gryffindor House Rug: A rectangular carpet.
  3. Flying Ford Anglia & Patronus Window: Scene changes with the day/night cycle.
  4. Cloud Sea & Owls Window: Scene changes with the day/night cycle.
  5. Stairwell Nook Window: Scene changes with the day/night cycle.
  6. Sword of Gryffindor: A wall decoration with lighting.
  7. Deluminator: An animated decoration that can be placed on tables, featuring lights.
  8. Red-Flame Goblet of Fire: Right-click to toggle the flame.
  9. Firebolt Bench: A two-seater bench; right-click to sit.
  10. Animated Snowy Christmas Window: An animated decoration with festive lighting. 
  11. Snowman Lamp Post: An animated decoration with warm lighting.

AT Furniture:
Adds additional Gryffindor-themed furniture.Requires the AT (Alternative Textures) mod as a prerequisite.Please refer to the detail images for the specific furniture items included.

Important Note:
The FF furniture and AT furniture arenot simply different versions of the same items. They are designed to complement each other, forming one complete furniture set. Therefore, you need to install both prerequisite mods!
